brief:
Hussein al-Sheikh, Palestinian vice president, said the decision to hold legislative elections in November will not be reversed, Middle East Eye reported. Al-Sheikh ruled out Hamas' participation in the vote, contrary to demands that the militant group be included in the electoral process.

The timing of the election announcement comes as Palestinian political factions remain divided over governance and representation. The exclusion of Hamas from the November ballot reflects deepening rifts between the Palestinian Authority and the group, which has controlled Gaza since 2007. Al-Sheikh's firm stance suggests the leadership intends to proceed with elections limited to other parties and candidates aligned with the Authority's vision for Palestinian institutions.
